{{Top}}
'''Armorplast''' was an advanced, light weight, ceramic version of the popular metal [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. Because of its expensive price it was only used for top priority subjects. It was used mainly used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to armor [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]], as it was capable of deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts. [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] mechanical body and mask employed armorplast plates.
